item.title: Lions stretch win streak to three games, 88-54 at Llano
item.description: LLANO – The Brownwood Lions stretched their win streak with three games with an 88-54 road victory over Llano Tuesday afternoon. The Lions (3-2) led 14-9 after one quarter, 46-26 at halftime, and 70-37 through three periods.
